ModMetaData.name: Borders of the Rim
ModMetaData.author: NehsModsForDev
ModMetaData.description: Transforms scattered faction settlements into geographic homelands with distributed capitals, major centers, towns, frontier outposts, evolving political territory, and visible borders. Worlds may begin with progressive regional claims that spread across reachable inhabited land or with their mature political borders already established; first contact creates a persistent disputed frontier, border tension, and eventual diplomatic or military friction. Settlement tiers have different influence, military strength, defense, mission value, and physical maps; native faction bases are augmented into compact outposts, expanded settlements, fortified major centers, and multi-district capitals. Capitals reserve one expansion for a coherent faction-specific landmark compound while retaining a native-style district and their full combined defenders. Generated sites gain tribal, civil, militarist, Imperial, xenotype, or industrial identity and visibly respond to war, occupation, stability, prosperity, coalitions, dependencies, and supply disruption. Factions wage territorial wars, form coalitions, establish protectorates and vassals, issue demands, split through civil war, and sometimes collapse. Territorial offensives and counterattacks can appear as save-persistent warbands that visibly travel along world routes before their battle or defense consequence occurs. Non-player factions also dispatch real, visible trade caravans between their own settlements; player caravans can intercept them to trade, let them pass, or launch a native caravan-battlefield ambush. Player colonies can intervene through six war-mission families or declare a player-led territorial campaign for the accessible front-line settlement of a bordering faction. Campaign defenders retaliate against nearby holdings through autonomous-colony defense crises or real raids on loaded colonies. After each conquest, players may consolidate, demand leverage-based reparations, or press through as many as three connected objectives; unresolved offensives may also purchase an early ceasefire. Conquered settlements can become preserved full colonies or specialized autonomous holdings that send supplies without consuming a normal colony slot. Player caravans may also spend carried resources to charter new autonomous colonies on unclaimed or player-controlled land while keeping every pawn and remaining item. Autonomous holdings support preferred support destinations, three costed levels, staffed conversion to direct control, hostile defense crises resolved through local funding, abstract garrisons, or player-fought tactical raids, and persistent specialization-based local exchanges where visiting player caravans can buy and sell through RimWorld's normal trade window. Personally defended holdings field level-scaled, technology-appropriate garrisons whose upgraded compatible equipment is secured through RimWorld's native biocoding system; ignored or failed defenses can permanently surrender the settlement to its attacker. Players may also transfer or raze captured settlements, proclaim sovereignty, and earn recognition as an independent territorial power. Existing saves retain every settlement location and current political claim, then initialize with the selected progressive or fully established border-development mode. [HSK local adaptation] Assemblies/BordersOfTheRim.HSKPatch.dll (source: Source/UsabilityPatch, rebuild via build.cmd) relaxes placement usability to non-water and non-impassable only, ignoring biome canBuildBase/settlement-weight and faction temperature curves, so capital placement stops falling back to expensive full-region resampling on biome-fragmented planets (world-gen capitals step measured 65.2s before this patch). The same DLL pins the homeland scatter radius setting to 48 and removes its slider from the mod settings screen (dense ~77-faction planet: compact homelands, settlement fields still grow with faction size; slider removal via IL transpiler). [HSK本地适配] 宜居判定放宽为非水域且非不可通行, 修复世界生成首都安置回退重采样导致的极慢问题。同一 DLL 把"家园散布半径"钉为 48 并从设置界面删除该滑条(密集派系星球保持家园紧凑, 场半径仍随派系定居点数量增长)。
